verdict.reasons: The candidate image correctly identifies the AFP drip tape product with authentic and readable branding. However, it fails the specific composition requirements of the QA feedback. The carton is placed on top of / directly overlapping the installed irrigation line in the foreground, rather than sitting on a dry soil island with the lines maintaining clearance to its right. This violates the instruction to separate the commercial carton from all installed plumbing. Additionally, the localized root-zone wetting evidence is a large, pooled puddle in the center, which looks more like surface ponding than the targeted soil wetting pattern typically expected from lateral drip tape. This combination of integration failure and imprecise evidence presentation keeps the score below the 90 threshold.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
